changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate model variants and consolidated language list. Added entity descriptions as a separate output type since both names and descriptions are generated. Removed 'Chinese' as a duplicate of 'Simplified Chinese'.
Simplified metric variants to base forms and removed duplicates. Added Recall and Mean Reciprocal Rank which are mentioned in the paper.
No LLMs are used as judges in this paper. LLMs are used as generation models, not for evaluation.

guideline: Annotators rated entity names on 5-point scale: 1-Incorrect, 2-Spelling issues, 3-Generic/rare/incomplete, 4-Good fit, 5-Perfect fit
Annotators verified names using web search before finalizing ratings
Annotators could opt out if insufficient context or knowledge

changes_made.explanation: Grouped the 5-point scale criteria into higher-level evaluation dimensions. Added missing guideline details about verification process and opt-out option.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on Knowledge Graph Enhancement (KGE) for generating entity names and descriptions in multiple languages. It involves NLG tasks but they are specialized (entity name/description generation rather than standard NLG tasks). Extensive human evaluation was conducted with detailed annotation guidelines. Automatic metrics include coverage, precision, recall, F1, and MRR for downstream tasks. No LLM-as-judge evaluation is used.
